status_semantics.SUPPORTED: The frozen structure directly licenses the role mapping.
status_semantics.PARTIAL: Some role content is directly licensed, but the frozen structure does not license the full Grammar-v0 interpretation or current formal signature.
status_semantics.ABSENT: No frozen support licenses the role; absence is not treated as ontological absence.
status_semantics.FULL: All required frozen claim structure has a lossless role-level projection under Grammar v0; implementation pressure may still be noted separately.
status_semantics.PARTIAL_verdict: The central frozen structure projects into Grammar v0 but some required relation semantics or formal topology remains unrepresented.
status_semantics.RESIDUAL: At least one required frozen structural object has no licensed Grammar-v0 role without retyping or invention.

grammar_distinctions_required_by_CH_A: T must remain distinct from K: CH01/CH09 contain explicit precedence in addition to non-temporal dependence/change.
P_in and P_out must remain distinct: CH05 contains both intervention/write and selective probe/read.
C must not absorb generic condition nodes: only CH05 has frozen resource_C support.
Q must remain non-necessarily-scalar: CH03 criteria, CH07 similarity weighting, and CH11 reference point are heterogeneous criterion structures.
Pi must permit non-physical individuation: CH03 system boundary, CH09 experimental grouping, CH11 gain/loss classification.
O must permit information and outcome positions and must not be assumed terminal.
K must remain relational/higher-arity and not necessarily functional.
Outcome ranking in CH11 is not temporal T.
Persistence cannot be universally rewritten as K = identity; CH-A contains no clean frozen carry-map witness.

Q-induced classification -> Q + Pi interaction (CH11; criterion-constrained Pi also CH03).

potential_threats_to_Grammar_v0: The recurrent null-axis condition subobject is a bounded direct-expressibility counterexample unless Grammar v0 treats such conditions as external parameters rather than internal roles; this lane does not make that repair.
The merged Lean formal skeleton is stricter than the Discussion-level definition of K as generic typed dependence; CH-A supplies several P-free, non-temporal, or cross-role dependencies.
The grammar lacks explicit negative/non-entailment relation semantics needed to preserve 'distinguishes' claims losslessly.
Using opaque X to hide ordered/algebraic internal structure (notably CH11) risks making the grammar vacuous unless later minimality tests constrain what may be absorbed into X.

counterexample_assessment.role_vocabulary_coverage: All nine named roles are independently required somewhere in CH-A; the counterexample concerns completeness/losslessness, not absence of role utility.
